batches.title: Eight titles that join two whole names with a slash: write and, or keep the slash?
batches.teaches: Your rule of Nov 18 writes a slash between words as and. These eight put a slash between two whole names, so the rename left them as printed for you to name. Seven are credential titles: DSST A History of the Vietnam War / Civil War and Reconstruction; Wall and Column Forms / Cutting and Burning (Carpentry); Video Gaming 1 / Computer Programming and Game Design; Standards and Training for Corrections (STC) / Board of Parole Hearings; Metal Building Erection 1 / Foreman Training; Nursing Skills / Clinical Simulation Laboratory Advanced; Water Treatment Operator Grade T3 / Distribution Grade D3. The eighth is a course on the re-point list that needs a new title: Emergency Medical Responder (EMR) / Healthcare Provider CPR.
batches.stop: It stands unless you change it.
